name: yfm-web
description: Yu-Gi-Oh! Forbidden Memories — web version with online PvP matchmaking

scripts.dev: npm run build:data && npm run build --workspace @yfm/engine && concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:data && npm run build --workspace @yfm/engine && npm run build --workspace @yfm/client && npm run build --workspace @yfm/server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @yfm/engine && npm run test --workspace @yfm/server
